title: The Primordial Seam Where All Metals Choose Their Shape

features.name: the choosing line
features.desc-on-touch: One pale seam runs through the earth here — not a boundary but a conversation. On each side stone and copper rehearse the moment they decided to be separate things.

features.name: copper's first doubt
features.desc-on-touch: A crystalline shape, almost too small to see. The moment copper thought about separating, before it knew it wanted to be metal.

features.name: stone's refusal
features.desc-on-touch: A knot in the seam. Stone learns copper is leaving and holds tight for one moment, then lets go.

inscription: the line between equals who chose to be strangers
